title: Drill-in shows no diff, report or gate evidence for settled and prior-run ticks
body:
A3. attemptDiff (report.go:286) reads only while the attempt branch exists, and sweepTick deletes it on close (dispatch.go:3667), so every merged tick's drill-in says 'diff not read'. Under `watch epic-<id>` a tick's row comes from the prior run that closed it, but the report reader is bound to the CURRENT run id (status_model.go:529) and is handed the prior run's per-run attempt number, which yields 'report not read' or another dispatch's report when the numbers collide. Gate evidence is the newest run's only (build.go:217). Record diff stats durably at collect (or diff the merged commit), key reports by (run, tick, attempt), merge gate evidence per tick across runs, and test a drill-in on a closed prior-run tick.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/report.go:286, :48-64; internal/reconcile/dispatch.go:3667; internal/cli/status_model.go:529; internal/statusmodel/build.go:217; internal/statusmodel/epic.go header
